en.title: ASEAN digital nomad visas: Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia compared
en.standfirst: Compare the main remote work and digital nomad visas in ASEAN, including Thailand's DTV, Malaysia's DE Rantau Pass and Indonesia's E33G visa.
en.metaDescription: Compare the main remote work and digital nomad visas in ASEAN, including Thailand's DTV, Malaysia's DE Rantau Pass and Indonesia's E33G remote worker visa.
en.body:
Remote workers considering a stay in Southeast Asia need an immigration pathway suited to their actual activities.

Three **ASEAN digital nomad visas** and programmes feature in this guide: **Thailand DTV**, **Malaysia DE Rantau**, and the **Indonesia E33G remote worker visa**.

Each has different financial, employment and permitted-stay requirements. Employer approval and tax planning also need attention before relocating.

## The tourist visa trap

Do not assume that permission to visit a country as a tourist also authorises your proposed remote work.

The relevant question is whether the immigration permission covers the activities you will undertake. Rules differ between countries and visa categories, so a blanket statement about every tourist visa across ASEAN would be misleading.

Before travelling, confirm your employer permits work from the destination. This guide identifies data privacy and corporate tax issues as matters requiring attention alongside immigration.

Visa permission and tax treatment are separate questions. A remote-work visa should not be treated as an automatic exemption from local income tax.

## Thailand's DTV

Thailand's Destination Thailand Visa includes a workcation category for remote workers, digital nomads and freelancers.

The DTV has **five-year multiple-entry validity**, with a permitted stay of **up to 180 days per entry**. The financial evidence requirement includes funds of at least **THB500,000**, alongside evidence supporting the relevant application category. [Royal Thai Embassy: DTV requirements](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa)

The five-year validity does not mean an unrestricted continuous five-year stay. Prepare around the authorised period for each entry.

Use the [official Thai e-Visa website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) and the requirements of the responsible embassy or consulate when assembling documents.

## Malaysia's DE Rantau Pass

Malaysia's DE Rantau programme provides a remote-work pathway administered by the Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation, or MDEC.

For the digital-professional category, MDEC's published guidance identifies annual income **above US$24,000** and supporting evidence such as employment or freelance contracts. The income figure should not be assumed to cover every professional category or later programme revision. [MDEC: Published DE Rantau guidance](https://mdec.my/static/pdf/derantau/DE%20Rantau%20Pass%20FAQ-Foreign.pdf)

The programme has provided an initial stay of up to 12 months with a renewal option. Because MDEC has announced changes to the framework, confirm the current application window, eligibility and renewal conditions before planning your stay. [MDEC: Current programme information](https://www.mdec.my/md-programmes/digital-nomad-pass)

## Indonesia's E33G remote worker visa

Indonesia's E33G route covers qualifying remote workers employed by companies outside Indonesia.

Official immigration guidance identifies a **one-year stay**, an overseas employment contract and annual salary of at least **US$60,000**. [Indonesia Immigration: E33G overview](https://ngurahrai.imigrasi.go.id/edukasi-visa-e33g-rumah-kedua-bagi-pekerja-jarak-jauh/)

Prepare employment evidence, financial records and the other documents required by the current application process. Use Indonesia's official immigration channels rather than relying on an older portal name or third-party summary.

Before choosing any of these destinations, assess immigration eligibility, employer permission and the tax implications of the planned stay together.

zh.title: 東協數位遊牧簽證：泰國、馬來西亞與印尼比較
zh.standfirst: 比較東協主要的遠距工作與數位遊牧簽證，包括泰國DTV、馬來西亞DE Rantau Pass及印尼E33G簽證。
zh.metaDescription: 比較東協主要的遠距工作與數位遊牧簽證，包括泰國DTV、馬來西亞DE Rantau Pass及印尼E33G遠距工作者簽證。
zh.body:
考慮在東南亞停留的遠距工作者，需要一條符合其實際活動的移民途徑。

本指南介紹三種**東協數位遊牧簽證**及計畫：**泰國DTV**、**馬來西亞DE Rantau**，以及**印尼E33G遠距工作者簽證**。

三者在財力、僱傭及准許停留期限方面各有不同要求。搬遷前，雇主同意與稅務規劃亦需納入考量。

## 觀光簽證的陷阱

不要假設獲准以觀光客身分入境某國，就等於獲准從事您計畫中的遠距工作。

關鍵問題在於移民許可是否涵蓋您將從事的活動。各國及各類簽證的規定不同，因此對東協所有觀光簽證一概而論會造成誤導。

出行前，請確認雇主允許您在目的地工作。本指南將資料隱私及公司稅務問題列為與移民事項同樣需要注意的課題。

簽證許可與稅務處理是兩個獨立的問題。遠距工作簽證不應被視為自動免除當地所得稅。

## 泰國DTV

泰國的目的地泰國簽證（Destination Thailand Visa）設有workcation類別，適用於遠距工作者、數位遊牧者及自由工作者。

DTV具有**五年多次入境效期**，每次入境**最長可停留180天**。財力證明要求包括至少**THB500,000**的資金，並須提供支持相關申請類別的證明文件。[泰國皇家大使館：DTV申請要件](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa)

五年效期並不代表可不受限制地連續停留五年。請依每次入境獲准的停留期限做規劃。

準備文件時，請以[泰國官方電子簽證網站](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/)及負責受理的大使館或領事館的要求為依據。

## 馬來西亞DE Rantau Pass

馬來西亞的DE Rantau計畫由馬來西亞數位經濟公司（Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation，MDEC）管理，提供遠距工作的途徑。

針對數位專業人士類別，MDEC公布的指引列出年收入須**超過US$24,000**，並須提供僱傭或自由工作合約等證明文件。不應假設此收入門檻適用於所有專業類別或日後的計畫修訂。[MDEC：DE Rantau公布指引](https://mdec.my/static/pdf/derantau/DE%20Rantau%20Pass%20FAQ-Foreign.pdf)

該計畫提供最長12個月的首次停留，並可選擇延期。由於MDEC已宣布調整計畫架構，規劃停留前請確認目前的申請期間、資格及延期條件。[MDEC：目前計畫資訊](https://www.mdec.my/md-programmes/digital-nomad-pass)

## 印尼E33G遠距工作者簽證

印尼的E33G途徑適用於受僱於印尼境外公司、符合資格的遠距工作者。

官方移民指引列出**一年的停留期限**、境外僱傭合約，以及至少**US$60,000**的年薪。[印尼移民局：E33G概覽](https://ngurahrai.imigrasi.go.id/edukasi-visa-e33g-rumah-kedua-bagi-pekerja-jarak-jauh/)

請準備僱傭證明、財務紀錄及現行申請程序所要求的其他文件。請使用印尼官方移民管道，而非依賴舊的入口網站名稱或第三方摘要。

在選擇上述任何目的地前，請一併評估移民資格、雇主同意及計畫停留的稅務影響。
